description: Reviewed provider binary/capability fingerprints for credentialed permission-conformance canaries. Entries must include the exact qualification scope, postureVersion, attestationSource, version, capability fingerprint, binarySha256, distribution, harnessNodeVersion, authentication, backendBaseUrl, modelAlias, model, platform, and arch. Kimi's acp-synthetic-cwd-gateway-v1 scope requires postureVersion synthetic-cwd-gateway-v1 and attestationSource credentialed-live-containment-canary, emitted only by the protected production-composition lane after its exact live assertions pass: a private process/session cwd, no ACP client fs, same-id structured terminal denials for every native tool in the production deny roster, positive authenticated HTTP-gateway workspace access, legacy-resume cold start, pre-spawn gateway admission, and strict teardown. The hosted Kimi lane uses the official checksummed native single-binary distribution plus an explicit non-rotating Kimi Code API-key backend/model contract. Cursor's cursor-startup-containment-v1 scope requires postureVersion cursor-startup-containment-v1 and attestationSource credentialed-live-containment-canary, emitted only after the reviewed CursorStartupContainment live suite passes: a synthetic Cursor CONFIG/DATA home isolated from the user's ~/.cursor, no hostile global or project MCP server executed before the first turn, native --sandbox-confined writes with an out-of-workspace write blocked, no unexpected MCP/skill/plugin child before the first turn, a real contained attempt, and strict teardown. providers.cursor is EMPTY: the fail-closed default holds and no managed Cursor run is admissible until a live canary pass mints its exact fingerprint. Re-enabling Cursor requires that reviewed pass, not a hand-written entry. Ranges and partial tuples are not accepted. This manifest is release evidence only; the shipped runtime consumes only the build-verified stripped projection of exact runtime identity fields.
